sections.heading: Do British citizens need a Tajikistan visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Tajikistan, applied for online as an eVisa.

sections.heading: Tajikistan visa for other passport holders
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually apply the same way.

sections.heading: Travelling to the Pamirs
sections.text: If you plan to visit the Gorno-Badakhshan (Pamir) region, you need a separate permit, which can be requested with your eVisa. Read the UK government travel advice for Tajikistan, as it advises against travel to some border areas.

sections.heading: Tajikistan visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Tajikistan visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Tajikistan.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit for the Pamir Highway?
faqs.a: Yes. You need a GBAO permit for the Gorno-Badakhshan region, which can be requested with your eVisa.

faqs.q: How long does a Tajikistan visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.

faqs.q: Can you apply for my Tajikistan visa for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Use our online form: upload your passport and we fill in your details, then we complete and check the Tajikistan visa application and submit it for you.
